<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
before=current_frame
res=action(['RIGHT'])
after=current_frame
def wcols(fr):
    L=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    W=[(r,c) for r in range(46,62) for c in range(10,50) if L[r][c]=='W']
    cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in W)); rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in W))
    return (min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs)) if W else None
def g(fr,r0,c0): return tuple(tuple(1 if fr.ascii.split('\n')[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def gl(fr):
    return {f"S{i}":g(fr,41,15+7*i) for i in range(5)}|{f"P{i}":g(fr,52,15+7*i) for i in range(5)}
gb,ga=gl(before),gl(after)
changed=[k for k in gb if gb[k]!=ga[k]]
print("result:",{k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','game_over','done')})
print("bracket before:",wcols(before),"after:",wcols(after))
print("glyphs changed:",changed)
